text.tspan: Threshold income per year marking the poorest decile (before tax)
Level of income per year below which 10% of the population falls. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living
costs between countries. Income here is measured before taxes and benefits.
Note: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Income has been equivalized.
